'''Sulan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Sulan attempted to connect with [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]] through Force-bonding exercises, but his attempts ended when [[Sulan's Padawan]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by one of the creatures.<ref name="Akk Dog" /> Stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he trained a sub-race of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rakghoul]]s, known as the [[Nekghoul]]s, to learn the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
When the player(s) defeat Sulan in combat, they have two choices:
*The dark side option involves overloading the reactor, killing all the nekghouls before the player executes Sulan.
*The light side option involves sparing the nekghouls, convincing them to discard Sulan’s teachings and embrace the dark side. They will then turn on and execute Sulan.
